summary: Discover effective strategies for Operational Risk Management in financial institutions. Enhance your risk assessment and safeguard your assets today.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for risk management professionals, senior managers, and advisors who need to establish, operate, or oversee operational risk management programs in financial institutions.
modules: Regulatory Context and Risk Governance Foundations
Operational Risk Management Framework and Policies
Risk Appetite and Tolerance Framework Development
Incident Data Collection and Loss Event Management
Risk Culture and Behavioral Risk Management
Key Risk Indicators and Early Warning Systems
Operational Risk Disclosures and Reputation Management
Scenario Analysis and Stress Testing Methodologies
Capital Modeling and Regulatory Capital Assessment
prerequisites: A fundamental understanding and interest in the basis of risk management.
